Not usually—drones send their reports to the companies’ own systems in real time, as far as I know. But I don’t see those reports, so I can’t say if they ever get mixed up or delayed.

If there’s a problem with timing, it’s something the companies would notice when they’re monitoring their own flights. My focus is just the airspace—like closures and corridors—so I don’t deal with individual drone reports.
